chain_reactions._description: REAL chain reactions — bottlenecks that propagate through value chains. Each chain has trigger, mechanism, propagation sequence, tier multipliers. Edward updatable.
chain_reactions._philosophy: Document REAL observed chain patterns (not theoretical). Mechanism must be CONCRETE (mass-balance, supply-demand math). Projections grounded in historical base rates.

tier_1_primary.description: Direct beneficiary of bottleneck (e.g., NVDA for AI compute)

tier_2_enabler.description: Enables the bottleneck product (e.g., HBM for AI compute)

tier_3_lateral.description: Supplies enablers (e.g., AXTI InP for HBM)

tier_5_speculative.description: Adjacent picks no one talks about yet

chains.name: AI Compute Cascade
chains.trigger_event: AI training compute doubling every 6 months (Epoch AI). 100x scaling required for AGI by 2027 (Leopold).
chains.mechanism: Each frontier model needs 10K-100K H100/H200/B100 GPU clusters. Single cluster $40K-60K capex per GPU. NVDA monopoly creates pricing power that cascades upstream as supply constraints bind at each layer.

propagation_sequence.rationale: Already moved 10x+ since 2023. Still has pricing power 2024-2026. Gross margin 75%+.
Hyperscalers desperate for non-NVDA exposure. Custom chips ramping.
HBM3e priced 4-5x DDR5. Sold out through 2026. CoWoS packaging constraint.
Cluster-to-cluster fiber. NVDA $2B capacity lock-in at LITE.
EUV monopoly (ASML), hybrid bonding (BESI), HBM packaging tools.
InP substrate for lasers (AXTI), pure silica fiber (GLW), advanced ceramics. TINY market caps vs explosive demand.

propagation_sequence.role: Co-Packaged Optics / CW lasers / TFLN modulators
propagation_sequence.rationale: Speculative early-stage. Binary outcomes. Position <0.5% each. CPO adoption inflection 2026-2028.

chains.name: AI Power & Grid Cascade
chains.trigger_event: Single 100K-GPU cluster draws 150 MW (city of 100K people). US grid interconnect queue 4-6 years. Hyperscalers contracting behind-the-meter solutions.
chains.mechanism: AI compute density × cluster size = power demand exceeds normal datacenter by 10x. Behind-the-meter solutions (gas turbines, SMRs, nuclear) bypass grid queue. Utilities with existing capacity get rerated multi-year.

propagation_sequence.rationale: PPAs signed at 2-3x spot. Multi-year contracts already booked.
Transformer lead times 2-3 years. Switchgear backlog historic.
US gas exports + behind-the-meter datacenter deals.
Nuclear renaissance + Russia ban. Spot uranium 2x since 2022.
LEU only US enricher. BWXT only SMR producer with active orders. Multi-year backlog.

chains.name: AI Cooling & Water Cascade
chains.trigger_event: GPU rack power density 4x by 2026 (H100 30-50kW → B200 80-130kW). Air cooling impossible >50kW/rack. Liquid cooling mandatory.
chains.mechanism: Compute density forces liquid cooling adoption. Direct-to-chip + immersion. Water consumption surges in semi-arid datacenter locations.

propagation_sequence.rationale: Pure-play with hyperscaler design wins.
Diversified players gaining datacenter exposure.
Heat dissipation infrastructure.

chains.name: Iran/Middle East War Cascade
chains.trigger_event: Iran-Israel conflict escalation, Strait of Hormuz risk, oil supply disruption fears.
chains.mechanism: Geopolitical risk premium → oil spike → tanker rates rerate (longer routes, fewer ships) → refining margins expand → insurance markets price in war risk → defense spending accelerates.

propagation_sequence.rationale: Direct geopolitical risk premium.

propagation_sequence.role: Tanker companies (longer routes = higher day rates)
propagation_sequence.rationale: Suez avoidance forces longer routes, fewer ships available, rates spike.
Crack spreads widen on supply uncertainty + product demand.
Defense spending accelerates. Ammunition restocking.

propagation_sequence.role: Indonesia oil & gas (ENRG benefits from sustained price)
propagation_sequence.rationale: Bakrie ENRG: 13 oil & gas blocks, $1.4B capex target through 2030.

chains.name: Russia/Ukraine War Cascade
chains.trigger_event: Russian gas weaponization, Ukraine grain corridor disruption, fertilizer supply chain shock.
chains.mechanism: Gas/oil disruption → LNG export premium → fertilizer cost crisis → food security panic → Eastern Europe defense rearmament.

chains.name: NAND Memory Cycle + AI Storage (SNDK Case Study)
chains.trigger_event: 2022-2024 NAND oversupply crash (-70% prices) → major suppliers cut capex 30-50%, idle fabs. AI inference workloads scale 2025+ requiring petabytes of storage per cluster.
chains.mechanism: Supply destruction during cyclical bottom creates undersupply 2025+ AS AI demand layers on TOP of normal cyclical recovery. Pure-play NAND benefits MOST vs diversified memory.
chains.horizon: Q1 2025 - Q4 2027 (cyclical 8 quarters + AI structural overlay)

worked_example_sndk.thesis: How could SNDK go from $30 to $1500+ scenario

components.mechanism: Capex cuts 30-50% during 2022-24 oversupply = fab idling = supply constraint when demand returns. Historical NAND cycles: peak/trough ratios 8-12x.

components.layer: AI inference storage demand bump (NEW non-cyclical layer)
components.mechanism: Each LLM cluster needs PB-scale storage. Enterprise SSD demand +40% YoY for AI. This is INCREMENTAL on top of cyclical recovery — uncorrelated demand source.
SNDK now pure NAND vs diversified MU. Investors pay premium for pure-play exposure. Historical pattern: spinoffs trade at premium 6-18 months post-separation.
Once analyst coverage initiated + sell-side recognizes AI storage thesis = multiple expansion from cyclical low (~5x P/E) to growth multiple (15-25x P/E).

key_invalidations: AI demand normalizes faster than expected (capex pullback)
Capex floods back from competitors (price compression)
Macro Q4 recession kills cyclical recovery

propagation_sequence.rationale: Direct beneficiaries of cyclical + AI overlay.
Less pure exposure but more liquidity.
Equipment cycle follows memory price recovery.

chains.name: GLP-1 Obesity Drug Cascade
chains.trigger_event: GLP-1 efficacy proven (Ozempic, Mounjaro, Zepbound). 100M+ US adults addressable. Supply constrained on peptide synthesis + injection devices.
chains.mechanism: Drug efficacy → demand surge → manufacturing bottleneck → packaging glass/devices premium → behavior change cascades to food/fitness/services.

propagation_sequence.rationale: INVERSE — companies dependent on overconsumption face headwinds.

chains.name: Nuclear Renaissance Cascade
chains.trigger_event: AI power demand + Russia uranium ban (Aug 2024) + climate policy + 50+ new reactors China/India by 2030.
chains.mechanism: Uranium spot rerating → enrichment monopoly (LEU) → SMR vendors → grid integration. Decade structural.

chains.name: Crypto 4-Year Cycle + Halving
chains.trigger_event: BTC halving every 4 years cuts new supply 50%. Combined with stranded power assets pivoting to AI hosting.
chains.mechanism: Halving → miner margin compression → consolidation → strongest survive with pre-connected power infra → AI hosting pivot (revenue $millions/MW vs mining $thousands/MW).

propagation_sequence.role: Miners pivoting to AI hosting (stranded power play)

chains.name: China Semi Decoupling Cascade
chains.trigger_event: US export restrictions on advanced semiconductor equipment to China (ASML EUV, US AI chips ban).
chains.mechanism: Restrictions force China to build domestic semiconductor industry from scratch. Massive government subsidies. Decade-long structural growth for Chinese players + rare earth/critical mineral plays.

current_developments.semantics: Dated research prompts. Date freshness is separate from human source verification. No entry creates direction or capital permission.

entries.title: Bank Indonesia July policy meeting is live event risk
entries.summary: Bank Indonesia's scheduled July policy meeting runs 21–22 July 2026. Pair direction must wait for the decision, guidance and price acceptance rather than infer from spot history alone.
entries.why_it_matters: USD/IDR can react to the policy path, intervention, global dollar conditions and positioning. Event risk should reduce position permission when evidence is incomplete.

entries.title: Prediction-market exchange applications and designations accelerate
entries.summary: The CFTC's DCM filing list shows a growing field of designated and pending prediction/event-contract exchanges during 2025–2026.
entries.why_it_matters: Distribution, regulatory licenses, clearing, market making and event-data quality are becoming a new financial-market stack. Volume alone does not prove durable economics.

entries.title: CFTC DCM designations broaden prediction-market and event-contract infrastructure
entries.summary: CFTC industry filings show multiple new or pending designated contract markets in June and July 2026, expanding the regulated venue layer for event contracts and adjacent products.
entries.why_it_matters: The chokepoints may shift toward licensing, clearing, market surveillance, liquidity distribution and brokerage access. A new venue designation is not proof of product-market fit or token value capture.

entries.title: USDC enters regulated derivatives-margin workflow through Coinbase and Marex
entries.summary: Coinbase reported that Marex is accepting USDC as collateral in regulated derivatives clearing with conversion and reporting infrastructure supplied by Coinbase.
entries.why_it_matters: Stablecoins are moving from exchange settlement into regulated collateral workflows. War Room must track collateral eligibility, haircuts, clearing-member adoption, custody and issuer/platform fee capture.

entries.title: Circle receives final OCC approval for a national trust bank
entries.summary: Circle announced final OCC approval to establish a national trust bank focused initially on federally supervised digital-asset custody, with reserve-management capability contemplated later.
entries.why_it_matters: Stablecoin competition is shifting from token issuance toward regulated custody, reserve infrastructure, clearing and institutional distribution. The investment question is fee capture, reserve economics and adoption—not a generic bullish stablecoin label.

entries.title: CFTC stays proposed 24/7 crude-oil futures listing
entries.summary: The CFTC stayed a self-certified NYMEX contract designed for continuous 24/7 trading while it reviews surveillance, reference-price and physically delivered commodity concerns.
entries.why_it_matters: Market-hours expansion can alter weekend gaps, liquidity, price discovery and manipulation risk. It does not change physical oil fundamentals by itself.

entries.title: Ethereum protocol-security team reports agent-assisted discovery and triage of real bugs
entries.summary: The Ethereum Foundation described coordinated AI agents testing protocol code and emphasized that triage and reproducible proof—not candidate count—determine whether a finding is real.
entries.why_it_matters: As agentic trading and autonomous onchain execution expand, security triage, reproducibility and permission controls become bottlenecks. Agent output is evidence inventory, not an oracle or automatic exploit-risk score.

entries.title: Robinhood Chain public mainnet and onchain distribution
entries.summary: Robinhood launched the public mainnet of its Arbitrum-based Layer 2, with Stock Tokens, DEX integrations, lending primitives and an explicit real-world-asset focus.
entries.why_it_matters: Distribution, tokenization, settlement, collateral and DeFi may converge inside a retail brokerage ecosystem. The investment question is who captures fees, liquidity and developer mindshare rather than merely who announces a chain.

entries.title: Stock Tokens become transferable DeFi assets
entries.summary: Robinhood made Stock Tokens available through its wallet in many jurisdictions, enabling 24/7 trading and potential use in lending pools and as collateral, subject to jurisdictional restrictions.
entries.why_it_matters: This changes the competitive map from tokenized price exposure to composable financial collateral. Legal form, redemption, issuer credit risk, liquidity fragmentation and underlying-share rights remain critical.

entries.title: Onchain lending and agentic crypto accounts enter retail distribution
entries.summary: Robinhood announced onchain USDG lending through Morpho-based infrastructure and plans for AI-connected crypto trading accounts using its Trading MCP.
entries.why_it_matters: The key shift is brokerage distribution of self-custody lending and automated execution. This creates new growth surfaces but also smart-contract, model, execution, monitoring and suitability risks.

entries.title: Retail 24/7 FX perpetual distribution expands in Europe
entries.summary: Robinhood began rolling out FX, commodity and ETF perpetual futures to eligible European users with leverage and 24/7 access.
entries.why_it_matters: This may change retail participation and weekend liquidity in derivative venues, but it is not evidence for long or short direction in any currency pair.
watch: spillover to regulated futures and spot

entries.title: Bank Indonesia raises BI-Rate to 5.75%
entries.summary: Bank Indonesia raised the BI-Rate by 25 basis points to 5.75% after earlier increases, emphasizing rupiah stability while maintaining growth support.
entries.why_it_matters: Banks, duration, domestic liquidity, foreign flows and USD/IDR respond differently. The action must be transmitted through pair-, sector- and company-specific channels.

entries.title: Indonesia amends financial-sector law and mandates IDX demutualization path
entries.summary: Indonesia enacted Law No. 4 of 2026, including changes aimed at strengthening capital-market governance through IDX demutualization and expanding OJK oversight of strategic mineral and commodity exchanges.
entries.why_it_matters: This is a structural governance and market-infrastructure change, not an immediate index direction signal. It may alter ownership, incentives, listings, surveillance and commodity-market linkages.

entries.title: SEC/CFTC crypto-asset interpretation changes the regulatory map
entries.summary: The SEC issued a Commission-level interpretation clarifying the application of federal securities laws to certain crypto assets and transactions, with related CFTC guidance.
entries.why_it_matters: Regulatory classification changes access, listing, custody, token design and capital formation. War Room must track asset-by-asset legal status rather than use a generic regulatory score.

entries.title: Nasdaq advances fungible tokenized-equity market design
entries.summary: Nasdaq described a design for tokenized equities intended to preserve issuer rights, fungibility and the existing regulated market rather than create a disconnected parallel market.
entries.why_it_matters: The chokepoints may sit in clearing, custody, transfer agency, identity, collateral and interoperability—not necessarily in speculative L1 tokens.

entries.title: Robinhood closes prediction-market exchange infrastructure acquisition
entries.summary: Robinhood's joint venture closed its acquisition of MIAXdx, giving it exchange and clearing infrastructure for futures and event contracts, with Susquehanna as a key liquidity partner.
entries.why_it_matters: Robinhood is moving from distributor toward vertically integrated market infrastructure. Monitor whether economics migrate from order flow to exchange, clearing and data layers.

entries.title: U.S. stablecoin framework becomes law
entries.summary: The GENIUS Act established a U.S. federal framework for payment stablecoins.
entries.why_it_matters: Stablecoin growth can affect Treasury demand, payments, exchange liquidity and onchain credit. Track issuer economics, reserve composition, distribution and regulatory compliance rather than stablecoin market cap alone.

crypto.title: Prediction-market exchange applications and designations accelerate
crypto.summary: The CFTC's DCM filing list shows a growing field of designated and pending prediction/event-contract exchanges during 2025–2026.
crypto.why_it_matters: Distribution, regulatory licenses, clearing, market making and event-data quality are becoming a new financial-market stack. Volume alone does not prove durable economics.

crypto.title: CFTC DCM designations broaden prediction-market and event-contract infrastructure
crypto.summary: CFTC industry filings show multiple new or pending designated contract markets in June and July 2026, expanding the regulated venue layer for event contracts and adjacent products.
crypto.why_it_matters: The chokepoints may shift toward licensing, clearing, market surveillance, liquidity distribution and brokerage access. A new venue designation is not proof of product-market fit or token value capture.

crypto.title: USDC enters regulated derivatives-margin workflow through Coinbase and Marex
crypto.summary: Coinbase reported that Marex is accepting USDC as collateral in regulated derivatives clearing with conversion and reporting infrastructure supplied by Coinbase.
crypto.why_it_matters: Stablecoins are moving from exchange settlement into regulated collateral workflows. War Room must track collateral eligibility, haircuts, clearing-member adoption, custody and issuer/platform fee capture.

crypto.title: Circle receives final OCC approval for a national trust bank
crypto.summary: Circle announced final OCC approval to establish a national trust bank focused initially on federally supervised digital-asset custody, with reserve-management capability contemplated later.
crypto.why_it_matters: Stablecoin competition is shifting from token issuance toward regulated custody, reserve infrastructure, clearing and institutional distribution. The investment question is fee capture, reserve economics and adoption—not a generic bullish stablecoin label.

crypto.title: Ethereum protocol-security team reports agent-assisted discovery and triage of real bugs
crypto.summary: The Ethereum Foundation described coordinated AI agents testing protocol code and emphasized that triage and reproducible proof—not candidate count—determine whether a finding is real.
crypto.why_it_matters: As agentic trading and autonomous onchain execution expand, security triage, reproducibility and permission controls become bottlenecks. Agent output is evidence inventory, not an oracle or automatic exploit-risk score.

crypto.title: Robinhood Chain public mainnet and onchain distribution
crypto.summary: Robinhood launched the public mainnet of its Arbitrum-based Layer 2, with Stock Tokens, DEX integrations, lending primitives and an explicit real-world-asset focus.
crypto.why_it_matters: Distribution, tokenization, settlement, collateral and DeFi may converge inside a retail brokerage ecosystem. The investment question is who captures fees, liquidity and developer mindshare rather than merely who announces a chain.

commodity.title: CFTC stays proposed 24/7 crude-oil futures listing
commodity.summary: The CFTC stayed a self-certified NYMEX contract designed for continuous 24/7 trading while it reviews surveillance, reference-price and physically delivered commodity concerns.
commodity.why_it_matters: Market-hours expansion can alter weekend gaps, liquidity, price discovery and manipulation risk. It does not change physical oil fundamentals by itself.

fx.title: Bank Indonesia July policy meeting is live event risk
fx.summary: Bank Indonesia's scheduled July policy meeting runs 21–22 July 2026. Pair direction must wait for the decision, guidance and price acceptance rather than infer from spot history alone.
fx.why_it_matters: USD/IDR can react to the policy path, intervention, global dollar conditions and positioning. Event risk should reduce position permission when evidence is incomplete.

doctrine: Start from an important decision problem, not an available dataset.
Detect what has already changed before forecasting what may change.
Study historical winners and losers; explain mechanisms, not resemblance.
Record contradictory evidence and uncertainty explicitly.
Explain the rational counterparty and the source of advantage.
Run the cheapest valid falsifier against a strong market-specific baseline.
Ablate complexity and inspect failure piles, not only aggregate metrics.
No prospective evidence means no capital permission.
Fresh official-source changes require human review and never become automatic directional claims.
FX is pair-specific; a price-only state can never become a triggered watch.
Options and Greek modules appear only where product and data capability gates pass.
Generic OHLCV screens are context screens, never directional selectors.
No scenario headroom, probability or EV without point-in-time economic inputs and calibrated probabilities.
